title.narrative: Promoting Inclusive Sports and Physical Activities Towards Enhancing Children's Holistic Development and Education

description.narrative: The project aims to enhance the knowledge and skills of school sports instructors (SSIs) in advocating for and implementing sports and physical activities (SPA) using contemporary and inclusive approaches. The first National Fitness Test (FT) conducted in 2023 revealed concerning findings, indicating a significant number of students needing to improve their health and fitness levels. Additionally, the Ministry of Health has highlighted a rise in mental health issues among school youth and the prevalence of non-communicable diseases (NCDs). While the Scouts and Sports Division continues to promote sports and physical activities, it has been observed that not all children have access to sports due to a lack of resources and sports infrastructure. Therefore, there is a pressing need to focus on non-traditional sports (free play), which are easy to organise, inexpensive, and beneficial to child development and education. The project will prioritize primary schools, as it is crucial to ensure early foundational development and progression in children's physical and mental well-being.
